description: A large modern open-plan corporate office photographed from mid-space, showing multiple rows of workstations. The workstations are configured in back-to-back benching clusters with light maple wood worksurfaces and dark charcoal grey panel dividers. Black ergonomic task chairs populate each station. Divider partitions between clusters incorporate built-in planter boxes with lush green leafy plants adding life and biophilic character throughout. An orange accent open-cube storage unit punctuates one partition end with a vivid pop of saturated color. Dark anthracite free-standing bookcases run along the perimeter walls and between window bays, stacked with books and binders. Full-height picture windows wrap the far wall and side wall, offering a wide cityscape view outside — urban buildings and hazy sky visible through the glass. The floor is dark charcoal commercial carpet tile with a subtle grid pattern. The white ceiling is clean and flat. Bright, even, cool-white illumination floods the space horizontally, with multiple linear bars of light suspended at different heights adding a layered distributed glow across the workspace. Camera at standing eye-level, three-quarter corner wide-establishing composition showing the full depth and breadth of the open plan, lens at wide character.
